reason: Free listing I might let them do since it costs me nothing, but I won't pay a cent for a platform until I've seen it bring people through my door. I've been burned by promo apps before, and 500 sign-ups is not 500 people who come to my bar.
objection: 500 people on a waitlist doesn't mean anyone will actually open the app and show up on a Thursday night. I've heard this pitch before and the audience never came.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real results first: the app live with 2,000+ active users in my city and a few bars nearby telling me it filled their room.
